card.name: The word long in long QT syndrome
card.fires_on: The word "long" at the start of "long QT syndrome", usually right after "congenital" or "familial" in lists of heart-rhythm risk factors.

modes.label: After congenital or familial
modes.description: "long" follows "congenital" or "familial" in a contraindication or warning list.
modes.example: Avoid ondansetron in patients with congenital<< long>> QT syndrome.

modes.label: After a list item
modes.description: "long" opens the phrase directly after a comma or "or" in a list of conditions.
modes.example: severe hypomagnesemia, or<< long>> QT syndrome.
